meaning.en: Type 2 connector (IEC 62196-2, "Mennekes"), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: Typ-2-Stecker (IEC 62196-2, „Mennekes“), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: IEC 62196-2 itself not consulted (paywalled). Contact layout checked against two public drawings: Wikimedia Commons "File:Stecker-Typ 2 Belegung.svg" (public domain; Type 2 plug "bei Sicht auf die Steckkontakte", male contact face: top PP, CP; middle L1, PE, N; bottom L2, L3), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Stecker-Typ_2_Belegung.svg, and "File:IEC 62196-2 Type 2 (plug).svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; end view of the female connector: top CP, PP; middle N, PE, L1; bottom L3, L2, i.e. the mirror image), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IEC_62196-2_Type_2_(plug).svg. Both retrieved 2026-10-21. The icon shows the male vehicle inlet seen from the front, which matches the male contact face.
